request: Analyze GSE285114 for PMID 41542103 (LOXL2 alleviates post-traumatic knee osteoarthritis and pain.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, HISAT2 + featureCounts, mm10), mouse knee joint
final.primary_estimand: Effect of cartilage-specific Loxl2 deletion (Tm-induced Acan-CreERT2; Loxl2fl/fl) on knee-joint gene expression in DMM-induced post-traumatic OA mice (Loxl2-/- DMM vs Loxl2 WT/vehicle DMM). Genotype contrast within injured mice; no exercise arm.
final.sample_inclusion: 8 knee-joint samples, n = 4 per condition (S2.3.p1, S4.8.p1): Vehicle_DMM_LOXL2wt x4, KO_DMM_LOXL2ko x4
planned_contrasts: KO_DMM vs Vehicle_DMM (Fig. 3b, S2.3.p1; paper: ~4046 DEGs at padj < 0.05, Table S1)
final.exercise_role: Treadmill exhaustion test (S2.7.p1, S4.5.p1, Fig. 7) is a functional/pain readout in a separate adenovirus-LOXL2 intra-articular cohort; those mice were not sequenced. No exercise intervention or exercise-vs-sedentary factor exists in the RNA-seq design.
final.paper_method: DESeq2 Wald test, BH adjustment (S4.8.p1, S4.10.p1)
final.paper_results: ~4046 DEGs padj < 0.05; Mmp13, Postn, Col1a1 up; Thbs2, Cdh11, Col3a1 up (S2.3.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.3.p1 and FIG3 define the only RNA-seq comparison: Loxl2-deleted DMM vs Loxl2-intact DMM mice, n = 4/group, DESeq2, padj < 0.05, ~4046 DEGs. S6.p1 deposits these data as GSE285114. Exercise appears only as a treadmill exhaustion behavioural test (S4.5.p1, S2.7.p1) in an adenoviral LOXL2 treatment cohort that was not profiled by RNA-seq. S4.9.p1 reanalyses human GSE114007 (OA vs healthy), also not exercise.

checks: S6.p1 names GSE285114 as the Loxl2-deleted DMM RNA-seq
library names Vehicle_DMM_LOXL2wt_Rep1-4 / KO_DMM_LOXL2ko_Rep1-4 match the paper's two conditions
contact Manish V. Bais, Boston University, matches paper authors

ownership.reasoning: Paper's data availability (S6.p1) names GSE285114; sample count and library names match the described design.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal the library name inside the GEO description field (inspect alignment_keys: 8/8). grp derived from the library name prefix (Vehicle = Loxl2 WT, KO = Loxl2 deleted).

matrix.recommended_method: limma on log2(x+1) as deviation (raw counts not deposited)
matrix.reasoning: File name and data_processing say 'normalized count for each samples'; only 5.5% integers, median ~84, consistent with size-factor-normalized counts, not raw counts. Raw counts not deposited in GEO. Recorded for completeness; the case stops at design.

final.available_contrast: grp_KO_vs_WT (Loxl2 genotype within DMM; not an exercise estimand)

candidates.reason_rejected: genotype (Loxl2 deletion) contrast in DMM mice; no exercise exposure differs between arms
behavioural readout in an adenoviral LOXL2 IA cohort; those mice were not sequenced and GSE285114 contains no such samples

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE285114 contains only Loxl2 KO vs WT DMM knee joints (n=4/group). Exercise appears only as a treadmill exhaustion behavioural test in unsequenced mice (S2.7.p1, S4.5.p1), so the data cannot identify an exercise effect on gene expression.
design.reasoning: The request asks how exercise affects gene expression. The only sequenced comparison is genotype; both arms underwent DMM surgery and no exercise/training variable is recorded in GEO or the paper for these samples. Manufacturing an exercise estimand from a genotype contrast would be invalid.

discrepancies.paper: featureCounts raw counts analysed with DESeq2 (S4.8.p1)
discrepancies.data: GEO deposits only a normalized-count matrix

discrepancies.paper: treadmill exhaustion test as a functional readout (S4.5.p1) in an unsequenced cohort
discrepancies.data: no exercise factor among the 8 GEO samples
